findings.documented: the API key is supplied as the api_key query parameter
findings.actual: the service rejects query-key authentication and requires X-API-Key
findings.how_found: called login once with the documented query parameter and read the 401 error
findings.impact: every documented request fails until the header is corrected

findings.documented: returns token, no refresh flow, and a 24-hour access token
findings.actual: returns access_token plus refresh_token, advertises /auth/refresh, and the access token lasts 900 seconds
findings.how_found: logged in and inspected both the response fields and expires_in
findings.impact: a frontend that follows the reference stops working after 15 minutes

findings.documented: no refresh flow exists
findings.actual: POST accepts refresh_token and rotates both tokens
findings.how_found: followed refresh_url from the real login response and exercised it
findings.impact: this is the supported way to keep a session working beyond 15 minutes

findings.documented: invalidates the bearer token server side
findings.actual: tokens are stateless; the response instructs the client to discard them
findings.how_found: called logout and read its success note
findings.impact: logout is a client-side token deletion, not server-side revocation

findings.documented: collections use 1-indexed page, default limit 20, maximum 200, and return total/page/page_size/results
findings.actual: page is ignored; offset is accepted; limit is capped at 50; responses use limit/offset/count/total/has_more/results
findings.how_found: compared page=2 with offset=20, requested limit=500, and inspected the echoed metadata
findings.impact: page-based clients loop over the first page and clients trusting the documented shape cannot paginate

findings.documented: total is the exact number of matching records
findings.actual: total reports 4365, but following has_more retrieves 4700 records
findings.how_found: continued advancing offset until has_more became false instead of stopping at total
findings.impact: 335 listing records are missed by clients that trust total

findings.documented: total is the exact number of matching records
findings.actual: total reports 1765, but following has_more retrieves 1900 records
findings.how_found: continued advancing offset until has_more became false instead of stopping at total
findings.impact: 135 rental records are hidden past the advertised total

findings.documented: total is the exact number of matching records
findings.actual: total reports 483, but following has_more retrieves 520 records
findings.how_found: continued advancing offset until has_more became false instead of stopping at total
findings.impact: 37 projects are hidden past the advertised total

findings.documented: returns active listings only
findings.actual: returns both states; 978 retrievable records have is_live=false
findings.how_found: paged the full endpoint and counted the undocumented is_live field
findings.impact: inactive and withdrawn inventory would be shown unless the frontend filters it

findings.documented: min_price and max_price filter inclusively
findings.actual: both parameters are accepted but ignored
findings.how_found: requested extreme bounds and found the response IDs, total, and out-of-range values unchanged
findings.impact: server-filtered search shows homes outside the requested budget

findings.documented: furnishing performs an exact filter
findings.actual: furnishing is accepted but ignored on sale listings
findings.how_found: requested furnishing=unfurnished and observed all furnishing values in the first page
findings.impact: the application must apply this filter itself

findings.documented: returns one listing
findings.actual: the singular path returns 404
findings.how_found: called it with a known listing ID
findings.impact: documented listing-detail links fail

findings.documented: not listed
findings.actual: the plural path returns the listing detail
findings.how_found: tested the plural resource path after the singular route failed
findings.impact: the frontend can provide stable detail URLs using this route

findings.documented: returns up to ten comparable listings
findings.actual: returns 404 for a known listing
findings.how_found: called the route with a retrievable listing ID
findings.impact: similar homes must be computed locally or omitted

findings.documented: GET/POST/DELETE manage per-user favourites
findings.actual: the path returns 404
findings.how_found: called the documented collection after logging in
findings.impact: saved-listing functionality fails at the documented path

findings.documented: not listed
findings.actual: GET, POST with {listing_id}, and DELETE /v1/saved/{id} provide persistent per-user saved listings
findings.how_found: located the replacement route, saved a record with demo3, re-read it, deleted it, and restored the account
findings.impact: this replacement enables the required saved-listing feature

findings.documented: returns precomputed city aggregates
findings.actual: returns 404
findings.how_found: called the documented route with valid authentication
findings.impact: the insights screen has to compute aggregates from retrievable data

findings.documented: area is square feet everywhere
findings.actual: 389 MagicHomes listing records use square metres for small raw carpet/super-area values; multiplying by 10.7639 produces the consistent square-foot values
findings.how_found: split area distributions by website and cross-checked duplicate properties across sources
findings.impact: unconverted homes look about 10.76 times smaller and price per square foot is overstated

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are integer rupees
findings.actual: values below 10 are crores and values from 10 upward are lakhs; fields can mix units within one project
findings.how_found: compared distributions and normalized each bound to plausible INR magnitudes
findings.impact: raw display and raw numeric sorting produce incorrect prices and ordering

findings.documented: deposit is rupees
findings.actual: ZeroBroker deposit is a number of months (2-10); deposit INR is deposit multiplied by monthly rent
findings.how_found: grouped deposit ranges by source and found every ZeroBroker value was 2-10 while other sources returned INR
findings.impact: raw display understates deposits by tens or hundreds of thousands of rupees

findings.documented: each listing record corresponds to exactly one distinct physical property
findings.actual: 335 appended records resolve to earlier properties after normalizing names, units, small coordinate/area variations, and stable physical attributes
findings.how_found: clustered the records by canonical project name, locality, type, BHK, bath, floor, building height, nearby coordinates, and near-equal areas
findings.impact: record count overstates distinct inventory

findings.documented: returned records are safe to show
findings.actual: 56 records contain impossible prices, areas, floors, bedroom/type combinations, coordinates, or future posting dates
findings.how_found: applied independent physical and temporal invariants after normalizing known units
findings.impact: these records corrupt search results and aggregates

findings.documented: posted_by_contact is the seller's verified contact and is_verified means operations checked the listing
findings.actual: 170 records belong to seven coordinated lead-generation phone clusters despite every record being marked verified
findings.how_found: combined unusually dense cross-site phone reuse, 100% agent/verified flags, low cluster median price per sqft, identity churn, and payment-pressure wording
findings.impact: users may contact lead collectors or pay token amounts for non-genuine inventory

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with currently available project listings
findings.actual: 127 projects disagree with the count of retrievable is_live listing records for that project
findings.how_found: grouped all live listing records by project_id and compared every project
findings.impact: project availability counts are unreliable

findings.documented: the rental object presents a coherent listing title and locality
findings.actual: 1691 records name a different locality in title than in locality and description
findings.how_found: parsed the locality suffix from every title and compared it with the locality field and description
findings.impact: displaying the supplied title mislabels most rentals
